t.zh: 证明器里的「下雨 ∧ 刮风」和<level-ref to="g-and"></level-ref>里的<part-ref to="part:gAnd"></part-ref>门同义：下雨，并且刮风。
t.en: In the prover, “it rains ∧ it is windy” means what the <part-ref to="part:gAnd"></part-ref> gate of <level-ref to="g-and"></level-ref> does: it rains, and it is windy.

t.zh: <level-ref to="decl-and"></level-ref>声明了「并且」，证明板上随之多了两块元件：<part-ref to="part:andI"></part-ref>是它唯一的引入规则；<part-ref to="part:andE"></part-ref>是由它生成的消去规则，两个输出口分别给出左边和右边。每个连接词都有一组引入规则和一组消去规则，这样组织的规则体系叫<wiki-ref to="natural"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: <level-ref to="decl-and"></level-ref> declared “and”, and the proof board gained two parts: <part-ref to="part:andI"></part-ref>, its one introduction rule, and <part-ref to="part:andE"></part-ref>, the elimination rule made from it, whose two outputs give the left and the right. Every connective has its introduction and elimination rules; a system of rules organised this way is called <wiki-ref to="natural"></wiki-ref>.

after.zh: 不依赖任何已知证出的话叫<wiki-ref to="theorem"></wiki-ref>：真值表上的永真式，在这里是证出来的。
after.en: A sentence proved from no givens is a <wiki-ref to="theorem"></wiki-ref>: a tautology of the truth tables, here proved.

hint.zh: 先拆开，再按新的顺序拼起来。
hint.en: Take it apart, then put it back together in the new order.

hint.zh: 刚才的证明可以整个搬进一个框里：框的假设拼成「下雨 ∧ 刮风」。
hint.en: The proof you just made can move into a box whole: assume “it rains ∧ it is windy”.

t.zh: 这一次没有已知：「下雨 ∧ 刮风 → 刮风 ∧ 下雨」是一句永远成立的话。
t.en: This time nothing is given: “it rains ∧ it is windy → it is windy ∧ it rains” always holds.
